messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: P0 PagerAlert - high error rate from serving-runtime in region us-west-2. 503s + crashloops observed on gpu-pool-3. Paging on-call: @Ana. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/serving/runtime-errors
Ana: on it, looking at graphs now. rough scope?
Derek: joining. seeing a spike in OOMs in the last ~6m on runtime pods; autoscaler events look very noisy.
Maria: pasting the tail of one of the failing containers logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:04.123Z ERROR runtime: CUDA out of memory when allocating 1024MB
2026-03-15T10:12:04.124Z INFO  runtime: killing worker pid=1032, exit_code=137
2026-03-15T10:12:04.130Z ERROR k8s: pod runtime-abc-xxxxx CrashLoopBackOff
```
Jun: I can confirm autoscaler scaled from 2 -> 8 -> 1 in a 3m window (hpa events: scale up 10:11:59, scale down 10:13:12, scale up 10:14:05, scale down 10:15:40). That thrash is causing pods to land on partially drained nodes and some GPU drivers to error.
Ana: initial hypothesis: rapid scale up creates more pods than GPU resources properly initialize for (driver/cuda warming), some pods hit OOM or CUDA init errors and die, kubelet marks node under pressure? Also we have backoff+restart loops which cause autoscaler to observe low utilization and scale down, repeat.
Derek: agree. Need immediate mitigations to stop thrash and reduce customer impact. Proposals (short-term):
- set hpa.minReplicas = 3 for serving-runtime in us-west-2
- set stabilizationWindowSeconds/scaleDownDelay to 300s (to avoid immediate scale down)
- disable scale-to-zero / reduce scale aggressiveness temporarily
- pin traffic to variant:runtime-v1-quant (lower memory footprint) for hosted in that region via routing policy fallback
- cordon + drain any nodes with repeated driver failures and restart node GPU drivers (nvidia-validate)
Maria: running the quick commands now. Patch to HPA:```bash
kubectl -n serving patch hpa serving-runtime -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 3}}'
kubectl -n serving patch hpa serving-runtime -p '{"spec": {"behavior": {"scaleDown": {"stabilizationWindowSeconds": 300}}}}'
```
IncidentBot: Deploy-bot: rollback of autoscaler-config commit 9f2a1e applied to cluster us-west-2 by Derek at 10:18:02.
Derek: rolling routing rule to fallback to runtime-v1-quant for new requests in us-west-2:```json
{
  "route": "hosted/*",
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "fallback_model": "runtime-v1-quant",
  "duration": "20m"
}
```
Jun: metrics after HPA patch + rollback: CPU stable, GPU memory use per pod dropped (the quant variant). Error rate dropped from 7.2% -> 1.1% over 10m. Latency p95 improved from 1.2s -> 700ms for affected routes.
Maria: drained two nodes with repeated driver logs, restarted nvidia drivers and kubelet. No more driver-init failures in recent 3m.
Ana: customer impact summary (to paste into incident report): hosted API in us-west-2 experienced elevated 503s for ~22m window. Some Dedicated customers on gpu-pool-3 saw 5-10% request failures and increased latencies; routing fallback reduced impact. No data plane compromise.
PagerDutyBot: Incident acknowledged by on-call Derek. Escalation: ENG-SRE notified.
Derek: handing over to SRE rotation for the next 2 hours, I'll stay on-call for postmortem. @Jun take lead on follow-up items and confirm longer-term HPA tuning?
Jun: will do. Immediate next steps tracked in incident ticket INC-2026-0456:
- follow-up: tune HPA behavior per workload (owner: Jun)
- add model-variant memory checks to rollout gating (owner: Maria)
- add autoscaler stabilization window to default config (owner: Ana)
- improve GPU node driver health checks and cordon automation (owner: Derek)
Ana: marking myself off-call. Patch to revert routing fallback scheduled after stability window.
Maria: deploy-bot: canary rollback completed at 10:34:22, all services reporting stable.
Derek: final note: root cause appears to be an overly aggressive autoscaler config + a recent model variant increase in memory footprint. Crashloops amplified autoscaler decisions creating a feedback loop. We'll schedule a postmortem with timeline and decisions.
Jun: adding logs/snapshots to the postmortem doc and linking relevant Grafana panels.
Ana: :thumbsup: Great coordination.
IncidentBot: Incident resolved (status: mitigated). Closing time 10:43:30. Follow-up CR scheduled for 2026-03-16.
Derek: leaving action items in the ticket and handoff done. If any anomalies reappear ping SRE rotation.
Maria: thanks team, good runbook improvements to capture here.
PagerDutyBot: This thread will be archived and linked to INC-2026-0456.
